image_description: A close-up view of a guenon monkey behind a metal wire cage. The monkey has a distinctive facial ruff, bare face with pinkish tones around the nose and mouth, and forward-facing eyes. The fur is a mix of olive-green and grey on the head and back, with white fur on the chest/neck area. The cage bars are in sharp focus in the foreground, partially obscuring the monkey's face and body.
